author: MasterPip
body:
I got an ornate T8 scepter from the one I found (the ljostifer scepter or whatever it's called). And I was T7 when I picked it up finally. Although the same as you I didn't know I needed to be full health to get it.

But I heard you can get junk from them too. Which honestly should be rare cuz I've been playing over a month and only ever found one.

Also, make sure you have overheal on in the options menu (or just manually use the potions) before you pick it up. Even though you auto use potions by holding the potions tab, it will not use a potion if it would overheal you to keep you from wasting potions.
